Hi Lydia —

Thanks again for taking the call today — appreciate the detailed questions from you and the security team. Per our discussion, I wanted to recap the items we agreed on and the next steps so we stay aligned: 

1) SOC 2 / compliance status
- Redwood is in-scope for SOC 2 Type II; we can provide the most recent redacted report.

2) Data residency / GDPR / HIPAA
- We support region-based hosting and can provide details on processing locations. For HIPAA, we offer BAAs for covered workflows; we should confirm your exact scope.

3) Encryption & key management (your primary ask)
- At-rest: All customer data at-rest is encrypted using AES-256.
- In-transit: TLS 1.2+ with modern ciphers.
- Customer-managed keys (BYOK): We support customer-managed keys via KMS integrations (AWS KMS, GCP KMS) and have HSM-backed options for Dedicated/Private deployments.
- Key rotation and access controls: Role-based access and audit logs; we can provide an architecture diagram and a short write-up.

Next steps we agreed on:
- I will share our SOC 2 redacted report and a short KMS architecture diagram (attached).
- You will confirm which sections of the vendor security questionnaire you'd like us to complete first (security controls, data flow, or legal).
- If helpful, we can schedule a follow-up with our infra/crypto SME (Aditya) to answer deep KMS/HSM questions.

Attaching: vendor_security_questionnaire_v1.pdf (blank copy for your team to pick sections) and kms-arch-diagram.png

Would Wednesday or Thursday next week work for a 30-min technical deep-dive with Aditya?

Thanks,

Marissa Cole

Hi Lydia —

Great, thanks for the specifics — we'll start with Security Controls + Data Flow.

Quick answers to your KMS questions (high-level):
- Customer-managed keys for hosted customers: Yes, supported via KMS integrations for enterprise-tier customers. For Hosted API customers we offer a managed-KMS option; for Dedicated/Private we support full BYOK where the customer controls keys in their KMS and we integrate via envelope encryption.
- HSM: We support HSM-backed key stores (AWS CloudHSM, Google Cloud HSM) for Dedicated/Private deployments; our Hosted HSM-backed offering uses provider KMS with FIPS-compliant modules.
- Key rotation / destruction: Rotation can be customer-driven via their KMS; we also support rotation policies. On termination we run secure key deletion procedures and provide attestations where required.

I'll loop Aditya (infra/crypto) into the deep-dive to cover architecture, HSM specifics, and attestation language.

Per your ask, I'm attaching our redacted SOC 2 Type II for procurement review (redacted).

Thanks — see you on 3/17 at 10am PT.

Marissa
